observation.visible_scene: A white tabletop holds several parallel rows of 3D-printed U-shaped holders in different colors (red, magenta, orange, yellow, light green, dark green, teal, blue, purple), each seating a small white rectangular domino-like piece standing upright; extra lines of plain white dominoes run along the front-left and back-right edges. The camera is fixed throughout.
visible_changes: At t=0 most white pieces stand upright, while a few (on the magenta and orange holders and several in the edge lines) are already tilted or lying flat.
The white piece in the back-center yellow holder tilts by t≈0.13 and lies flat by t≈0.20.
The plain white domino line at the front-left edge starts toppling around t≈1.0–1.2 and progresses along the row.
The light-green holder's white piece tilts around t≈1.5–1.6 and lies flat by t≈1.9.
The dark-green holder's white piece tilts around t≈2.0–2.2 and lies flat by t≈2.3.
The teal holder's white piece tilts around t≈2.4–2.6.
The front-yellow, purple, dark-blue and light-blue holders' white pieces remain upright through the end of the clip.
outside_clip_unknowns: The initial trigger that began the staggered toppling is outside the segment.
Whether the still-standing pieces eventually fall is not shown.
uncertain_details: Exact causal ordering between rows; some pieces may already have been mid-fall at the crop boundary.
No camera motion detected; background and lighting stay constant.
